subject: Medford High School MSBA Statement of Interest
overview: The City Council authorized the superintendent to submit a Massachusetts School Building Authority statement of interest for renovations at Medford High School. The council also requested traffic enforcement in South Medford, drafted restrictions on auto shop street parking, and sent back a legal settlement request over factual discrepancies.

items.title: Valley League Championship Commendation
items.summary: Congratulated the Medford Pee Wee Bee Hockey Team on their championship victory.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Subcommittee on Public Health and Community Safety on reproductive and gender-affirming care protections, and the Subcommittee on Ordinances and Rules regarding Chapter 70 solid waste updates.

items.title: Medford High School MSBA Statement of Interest
items.summary: Authorized Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent to reapply to the Massachusetts School Building Authority's core program for major renovations and modernization of Medford High School.

items.title: DCR and DOT Roadwork Follow-up
items.summary: Councilor Knight asked the administration to follow up with state agencies regarding incomplete road repairs near City Hall.

items.title: Auto Repair Facility Ordinance Update
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the ordinances subcommittee and the fire department to restrict auto body shops from parking vehicles and performing repairs on city streets.

items.title: Student Mattress Disposal Notification
items.summary: Requested that code enforcement notify Tufts University regarding the city's mattress disposal fee and report back on enforcing off-campus move-out trash regulations.

items.title: South Medford Traffic and Parking Enforcement
items.summary: Requested increased police patrols and weekend parking enforcement at Main Street and Harvard Street to address hazardous pedestrian and vehicle conditions.

items.title: Food Truck Permit
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for Neighborhood Produce.

items.title: Law Department Claim and Settlement Reporting
items.summary: Voted to send back a $3,450 accident claim to the law department due to conflicting incident dates on the document, and separately requested a comprehensive report on all municipal settlements and judgments.

items.title: Planned Development District Fee
items.summary: Passed an amendment to Appendix A of the Code of Ordinances for a third reading to establish fees for the planned development district.
